ClearAllFields.description: Clears all forms in the document.

GetAllForms.description: Returns all existing forms in the document.

GetFormKeysByRole.description: Returns a list of all form keys attached to the specified role.

returns.description: A list of all form keys attached to the specified role.

GetFormRoles.description: Returns a collection of form roles.

GetFormValueByKey.description: Returns the form value for the specified key. For a group of radio buttons returns Choice, i.e. the name of the selected item.

returns.description: Returns true/false for checkboxes and string for other form types. Returns null ifthere is no form with the specified key.

GetFormsByKey.description: Returns a list of all forms in the document with the specified key.

GetFormsByRole.description: Returns a list of all forms in the document with the specified role name.

GetFormsByTag.description: Returns a list of all forms in the document with the specified tag name.

GetFormsData.description:
Returns the data from all forms present in the current document.
If a form was created and not assigned to any part of the document, it won't appear in this list.

GetFormsHighlight.description: Returns the highlight color of the forms in the document.

returns.description: Returns the highlight color, or _null_ if the highlight is disabled.

GetTagsOfAllForms.description: Returns a list of all tags that are used for all forms in the document.

InsertTextForm.description: Inserts a text box with the specified text box properties over the selected text.

params.description: Properties for inserting a text field.
params.name: formPr

SetFormsData.description: Sets the data to the specified forms.

params.description: An array of form data to set to the specified forms.
params.name: arrData

SetFormsHighlight.description: Sets the highlight to the forms in the document.

params.description: The highlight color for the forms.
params.name: color
